rules.title: MyBatis string interpolation in SQL
rules.refuses: `${}` in a mapper or a MyBatis-annotated source
rules.silent_on: `#{}`, and `${}` anywhere that is not MyBatis
rules.constraint: never(interpolate): mybatis ${...} in mapper|@Select|@Insert|@Update|@Delete -- ${} is pasted into the SQL text before preparing; bind with #{...}

rules.title: Unescaped template output
rules.silent_on: the escaping sibling, and other `<% %>` forms
rules.constraint: never(write): th:utext|<%=|escapeXml="false"|?no_esc|<#noescape> -- these put a value into the page as markup; use the escaping sibling

rules.title: Unsafe polymorphic deserialization
rules.refuses: Jackson default typing; an XStream built with no allowlist
rules.silent_on: a plain `ObjectMapper`; an XStream that allowlists
rules.constraint: never(enable): jackson activateDefaultTyping|enableDefaultTyping; never(build): XStream without allowTypes|allowTypeHierarchy

rules.title: Wildcard CORS origin with credentials
rules.silent_on: a wildcard alone; a named origin; `setAllowedOriginPatterns`
rules.constraint: never(pair): CORS origin "*" with allowCredentials(true) -- the spec refuses it; name the origins, or use setAllowedOriginPatterns

rules.title: Every actuator endpoint exposed
rules.silent_on: named endpoints; a wildcard `include:` outside actuator config
rules.constraint: never(expose): management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=* -- it publishes heapdump and env; name the endpoints served

rules.title: JWT read without verifying its signature
rules.refuses: `parseClaimsJwt`, `parseUnsecuredClaims`, `Algorithm.none()`, `SignatureAlgorithm.NONE`; `JWT.decode` where nothing in the file verifies
rules.silent_on: `parseClaimsJws`, `parseSignedClaims`, a real algorithm, issuing a token, and a decode beside a verify
rules.constraint: never(call): parseClaimsJwt|parseUnsecuredClaims|Algorithm.none|SignatureAlgorithm.NONE, or JWT.decode where nothing in the file verifies -- they skip the signature; use parseClaimsJws|parseSignedClaims with a key

rules.title: Path built from request data
rules.refuses: a file path a method body shows request data reaching
rules.silent_on: a constant path; a name taken with `getFileName`; a parsed number
rules.constraint: never(open): a file path built from @RequestParam|@PathVariable|request.get* -- take getFileName, resolve against a fixed base, check startsWith

rules.title: Java deserialization of request data
rules.silent_on: a stream the application opened itself; the same bytes read as JSON
rules.constraint: never(construct): ObjectInputStream over @RequestBody|request.getInputStream -- the bytes name the classes; carry the payload as JSON into a declared type

bounds.review_before_apply: Every answer is a row you can tick and edit before anything is written. The java-security skill is the only thing that writes, and only after you have reviewed every row.
bounds.relaunch_to_edit: There is no separate edit mode. An existing selection prefills every rule's current verdict, so changing an answer means reopening this page, not finding a second flow.
bounds.sandbox: This page is a file: inline and offline, nothing it loads reaches outside itself, and nothing it does can reach the network.
bounds.accessibility: Every control is reachable by keyboard and carries a label a screen reader can read; no choice depends on color alone.
bounds.theme_choice: The page renders correctly in both light and dark themes on its own, and offers an explicit toggle besides.
bounds.verdicts_are_chosen_never_derived: A verdict is what you choose for a rule, never something inferred from a question about your stack. There is no field here a stack answer could land in.
bounds.plugin_tier_is_not_commit_or_ci: Installing this policy as an agent plugin reaches that agent's own tool calls and turn end. It does not reach a commit or a CI run -- those need the policy installed in the repository itself with chock.
bounds.nothing_written_from_the_page: This page writes nothing. It produces a result the java-security skill reads, shows you row by row, refuses to overwrite an existing selection without your say-so, and only then writes .chock/security.json.
